project.name: VelvetClaw Agent Swarm + RAG Memory Integration
assumptions: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector can run locally or in Docker on macOS
n8n is used as API proxy/security layer per Simon's recommendation
OpenClaw CLI supports --model flag for model routing
GitHub Actions is available for CI/CD pipeline
Telegram Bot API is available for notifications (with osascript fallback)
bats-core is used for bash script testing
All 11 VelvetClaw agents use the existing HEARTBEAT/TASKS/INBOX/CONTEXT file convention
risks: RAM constraints with 11 parallel agents (Elvis hit 16GB ceiling at 4-5 agents)
pgvector embedding costs at scale (1536-dim embeddings via OpenAI)
n8n single-point-of-failure for memory API proxy
Convex removal may break existing dashboard components not yet migrated
macOS sleep/lid-close kills cron jobs (Gap 2 from Stage 2 analysis)
Multi-model review pipeline cost (~$190/mo baseline from Elvis's data)
